Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 9. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C DIRECTOR RAJKIYA ENGINEERING COLLEGE KANNAUJ . For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Unconditional warranty of supplied and installed items/equipments for minimum 1 years to be declared by Bidder from the date of installation. The Warranty / Guarantee must cover all parts of the items/equipm ents. Datasheet of the product being quoted needs to be attached with technical bid documents. 2. The cost of equipment/ unit should be inclusive of all accessories as per detail given the specification an d detailed specification of equipment/ unit should also be mention on the quote. 3. The Department reserves the right to cancel/reject the bid without assigning any reason thereof. 4. The Department reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity as per actual requirement. 5. Payments will be released as per institute rules after satisfactory report /installation report of materials ( whichever is applicable). Wherever necessary, performance bank guarantee @ 3% of the ordered value s hall have to be submitted before processing for release of payment. 6. Rejected items would be removed by the supplier from the site within two weeks of the date of rejectio n at their own cost. In case they are not removed they will be auctioned at the risk and responsibilities of the suppliers without any further notice. 7. Bidder financial standing certificate: The Bidder should not be under liquidation, Court receivership or similar proceeding should not be bankrupt/Blacklisted by any Government Department/PSU during the l ast three years. For this bidder needs to upload a bid specific non-blacklisting and not bankrupted certifica te from any government department/agency on 100 Rs. notarized stamp paper which is made after the dat e of bid published and before the date of bid opening, and hard copy of the original stamp paper must be s ubmitted in institute. Absence of this the bidder is liable to disqualified/reject in technical stage/round. 8. Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyer

s can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 9. For fulfilling the experience criteria of bidder (last 3 financial year) any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria: · Purchase Order copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that supplies against the invoices have been executed. · Execution certificate by client with order value. 10. Local Presence requirement: · A local address in the consignee state. · Office address must be uploaded along with proof. 12. Amount of EMD for submission is as per bid. 13. ITR Return for Bidder of last 2 year should submit with the bid . 14. GST Return certificate of last six months. 15. Bidder should submit CA certified turnover of last three financial years of bidder and OEM. 16. Bidder should have a registered office/service support facility in Uttar Pradesh. For document proof b idder need to upload Office registration proof/GST registration. 17. Bidder should have a GeM Seller Rating of 4 or above. GeM Seller Profile/Rating Screenshot. 18. Bidder shall certify that all documents submitted are genuine and authentic. For this bidder needs to upload a bid specific Undertaking on 100 Rs. notarized stamp paper which is made after the date of bid pu blished and before the date of bid opening, and hard copy of the original stamp paper must be submitted i n institute. Absence of this the bidder is liable to disqualified/reject in technical stage/round 19. The delivery period should be clearly mentioned in the bid documents 20. Site Survey Certificate (Mandatory) · The bidder shall submit a Site Survey Certificate for installation and commissioning of the items/equipme nts as per the need of institute at REC Kannauj, duly issued by the concerned authority of REC Kannauj as per the institute rules. The report must be issued after the published date of Bid. · The certificate must be uploaded before bid submission by the bidder, without the submission of the site survey report the bidder must be disqualified in technical evaluation round. 21. Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid : Self-Attested copy of PAN CARD, GST registration, Cancel Cheque, Aadhar Card. 22. The quoted price shall include the cost of all materials, equipment, transportation, loading/unloading , installation, labour, tools, accessories, consumables, testing, commissioning and all other incidental expe nses. .
